LNG plant capex: 'US$ (2005)' (Table 5 caption). Compression capex $1484/kW: no currency year stated - 2008-2009 projects in nominal dollars; 2009 used as a flagged judgement. Sidecars: oil pipeline costs 2008 and 2009 nominal; tanker and LNG ship prices nominal by year; LNG opex in EUR (no year) converted in the summary at US$1.35/EUR; regasification costs no year.

Main file: three in-scope technologies. LNG liquefaction (liquefaction-train_natural-gas; nearest archetype chiller_gas-turbine, the base-load gas-turbine-driven train - not liquefaction-train_small-scale): Table 5 capex time series as five cases of one example ([1988 plant] ... [2003 plant]), fuel 15% of gas input as a derived natural-gas flow per GJ LNG, lifetime, construction time. Onshore gas pipeline compression (compressor_pipeline; driver not stated, nearest compressor_gas-turbine-drive): capex $1484/kW and compression energy per 1000 km for two regions as cases. Oil pipeline pumping (pump_pipeline; nearest pump_electric-station): energy 0.5% of energy transported. Sidecars (not loaded): _shipping-and-transport (oil tankers and LNG carriers, Tables 1-3 and 6-8, rail and truck - transport is out of scope), _pipelines (Table 4 pipe costs, lifetimes, spacing, leakage, transport costs - the pipe itself has no archetype), _regasification (no archetype; capex basis ambiguous), _lng-other (LNG opex, which is implausible and not loaded; chain cost shares; market), _projections (future LNG capex and fuel). Omitted: oil storage and strategic reserves, trade volumes by region.
